reference: The design reference for TshepoVet's web app (apps/web), as the code stands. Edit any value to request a change: it waits under "Requested changes" until Claude applies it. Colours, the type scale, the interface scale, radii, layout widths and motion timing go into the app automatically (`npm run design:pull` generates apps/web/app/tokens.css, and refuses colours under their contrast minimum); fonts, rules, brand text, components and page layouts Claude changes in the code.
name: The specimen and the seal
summary: TshepoVet's world is official paper: CIPC certificates, SARS PIN letters, B-BBEE affidavits, the supplier's passport. Security printing gives the vocabulary, used sparingly: the guilloche seal is the only ornament, stamps carry verdicts, the sandbox is marked as a specimen, and everything else is quiet: cool security paper, petrol ink, records with their 'as of' dates.

rules.title: Contrast (AAA)
rules.text: Every text pair is 7:1 or better (WCAG 1.4.6, AAA); control edges are 3:1 or better.

rules.title: Colour carries meaning
rules.text: Violet, green and red are never decoration: violet is 'you can do this', the stamp colours are verdicts.

rules.title: Reading
rules.text: Body text 16px with a 1.6 line height, under 72 characters a line; never justified.

rules.title: Plain words
rules.text: Abbreviations are expanded (<Term>, /glossary); errors say what went wrong and how to fix it.

rules.title: Radii by hierarchy
rules.text: Radii by hierarchy: a stamp is sharp, a control softer, a record sheet the softest.

rules.title: Targets and focus
rules.text: Every target at least 44 by 44 pixels; a 3px focus ring with an offset; a skip link first.

rules.title: Reflow
rules.text: No sideways scrolling at 320 pixels; reduced motion respected; no time limits.

rules.title: One ornament
rules.text: The seal is the only ornament: the brand, a verified passport, the sandbox band. Nothing else is decorated.

rules.title: Stamps carry verdicts
rules.text: A double rule in stamp ink, an icon and the word: Verified, Attention, Refused, Pending.

rules.title: The sandbox is a specimen
rules.text: Marked the way reference banknotes are, in plain words, on every page; paper copies print it too.

components.name: Button
components.description: Intents: primary (violet), secondary (outlined), quiet, danger; at least 44px tall. States: hover and pressed (darker; pressed also sinks 1px unless reduced motion is on), a 3px violet focus ring, disabled (60% opacity) and loading (keeps the label, blocks repeat presses). Transitions use the motion tokens.

components.name: Stamp
components.description: Verdicts: verified (green), attention (amber), refused (red), pending (petrol), each with an icon and the word.

components.name: Callout, Spinner, Skeleton, EmptyState, Meter
components.description: Notices with a tone and a title; a spoken loading label; empty pages that say what to do next.

components.name: Fields
components.description: Labels above fields, help under them, errors that say how to fix them; password fields can be shown.

components.name: Dialog, Menu, Popover, Tooltip
components.description: Radix primitives; menus are non-modal and not portalled, so the landmarks stay.

components.name: DataTable, Pagination, Tabs, Money, When, Term
components.description: Wide tables scroll inside a labelled region; rand formatted by hand (R1 250,00); dates as South Africans write them.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: The collapsible left sidebar of the portal and the staff console (Q1).

components.name: Seal
components.description: The guilloche rosette: the brand mark and the passport's seal.

components.name: Passport sheet
components.description: The one document that uses the whole vocabulary: seal, engraved border, stamps, printed verification code.
